content: Here is the draft for 30 September 2026, for your approval: In the period ending 2026-09-30, principal receipts of £4.88 million were applied sequentially and repaid £4.88 million of Class A notes. The arrears ratio fell to 0.84% from 0.97%, and the annualised prepayment rate was 14.8%. The reserve fund stands at its required amount of £6,082,667.80.
